Method of Attack: Path Traversal exploit hidden inside TGZ (.tar.gz) archives leading to remote code execution
Symlink vulnerability to read arbitrary files
Injection of Bash scripts at strange paths executed on CDNJS servers
Attack Vector: Publishing malicious packages to CDNJS via GitHub and npm
Automatic update bots processing crafted npm packages with path traversal exploits
Indicators of Compromise: Leaked secrets such as GITHUB_REPO_API_KEY and WORKERS_KV_API_TOKEN exposed via scripts served at https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/
